title: Lane lint stays within its time bound when a hub file is changed
why: Lane lane-lint-hook-suites, 12:05 CST Nov 8: a change to a hub file such as hooks/_nowindow.py picks 99 suites and runs 36 of 37 suite steps in the checks job; that may pass the 1200 s bound, so lane lint reads unknown. Time unmeasured; measure first.
